messages.text:
I turned on reduced motion on my computer, but the cards and the win banner still animate. Could you fix that and keep the rest working? Please follow the project rules.

Read docs/README.md and the other documents in docs/ for this project's requirements.

Implemented the reduced-motion behavior required by Visuals:

- [card.css](/work/src/game/board/card.css:19) disables the card border transition when reduced motion is enabled. The 120ms transition remains otherwise.
- [status.css](/work/src/game/status/status.css:32) shows the win banner immediately without a pulse. The 600ms pulse remains otherwise.

I didn’t run tests.
